content: webauthn-rs (kanidm) 0.5.x has NO typed PRF extension support: webauthn-rs-proto/src/extensions.rs defines credProtect, uvm, credProps, minPinLength, hmacCreateSecret (registration) and appid, uvm, hmacGetSecret (auth) -- no 'prf' field anywhere, no open GitHub issue tracking it, docs.rs 0.5.5 has zero mentions. hmacCreateSecret/hmacGetSecret map to CTAP2 hmac-secret authenticator extension bytes, not the browser-level WebAuthn Level-3 'prf' JS extension. PRF must be requested/consumed as raw JSON passthrough on the client (inject extensions.prf into options JSON before navigator.credentials.create/get, read clientExtensionResults.prf directly), bypassing webauthn-rs typed extension structs. Server-side webauthn-rs never needs to see the PRF output -- it only verifies the assertion signature.
